system.description: Requires a Humanity or Path rating of 4 or higher. Against a willing, unresisted subject, spend a Willpower Trait to cleanse demonic or malign spiritual taint. Against a resisting entity, engage in a series of Mental Challenges until one side achieves three more net victories; losing the contest fails the Purification, and losing three challenges in a row lets the entity possess you instead. Winning lets you spend another Willpower Trait to trap the expelled entity in a nearby item, animal, or person within two turns, or it escapes to find a new vessel. Cannot be used on yourself, and has no effect on the Beast or alternate personalities.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus a second to trap the entity)
